text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-4682 — embeddings-queue (eu-west1) queue length > 90%, processing lag > 120s. Auto-escalation in 3m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue

aj: saw it, looks like a burst from customer 'vector-stream'. I'm going to check consumer backlog and retries.

kevin: taking primary, acking in PD. @pagerbot please route future alerts to oncall_t2.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-4682 acknowledged by Kevin (kevin).

maria: I can spin up extra consumers now — running: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-consumers --replicas=8 -n prod-eu`

aj: logs show repeated retries causing backpressure: `ERROR: rate limit exceeded` with exponential backoff. snippet:
```
consumer.go:142: requeue delta=120ms attempts=6
consumer.go:148: failed to process item id=xyz123 err=rate limit
```

kevin: good call. Maria, after scale, please also watch memory/CPU. I'll put a soft API gateway rate-limit: `ratelimit: 120r/s` to blunt the burst while consumers catch up.

maria: scaled to 8 — pods ready 8/8. metrics: queue depth dropping ~15% in 30s :thumbsup:

oncall_t2: handoff noted — I'm on until 18:30 UTC, will monitor and escalate to SRE Lead if we re-spike.

aj: customer impact assessment: subset of realtime embedding requests delayed ~30-90s. No 5xxs observed, just increased latency. Notify CS?

kevin: yes, ping CS with short note. I added a short incident stub: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-4682 (will expand).

incidentbot: Auto-escalation canceled (manual ack present). Continuing to monitor for stabilization.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-4682 marked resolved by Kevin (kevin).

maria: filing follow-up: probable root cause = bursty replay from integration + insufficient sustained autoscaling policy for embed-consumers. Filing ENG ticket ENG-1125 to add sustained policy and circuit-breaker.

aj: thanks all — leaving monitoring window for 15m then will close. If anyone sees latency creep back up, re-open thread.
